name: Part 1: Slack Workbot shows Salesforce Case details when you post a URL in Slack
description:
1. Type or paste a **Salesforce Case URL** in the Workbot DM or in a channel Workbot is in.
2. Workbot will automatically reply with a message showing more information about that particular Case. 
3. Workbot will prompt you with 3 buttons to update, delete or close the case.

**Notes**
- This recipe works together with 3 other recipes. To use this recipe, copy and run: [Update Salesforce Case Priority](https://www.workato.com/recipes/382645-internal-update-salesforce-case-priority-by-case-id#recipe), [Delete Salesforce Case](https://www.workato.com/recipes/382643-internal-delete-salesforce-case-by-case-id#recipe) and [Close Salesforce Case](https://www.workato.com/recipes/382641-internal-close-salesforce-case-by-case-id#recipe)
- Workbot must be invited to Slack channels before it can post messages in those channels.
